say:1:1623341001:1.text: In the Lyceum Graveyard, you'll sometimes run into ghosts who never quite moved on. Most of them used to work here at the school.
say:1:1623341001:1.source_cn: 莱希拉姆墓园里，偶尔会有过去的幽灵驻足，他们多为曾在莱...
say:1:1623341001:1.male: In the Lyceum Graveyard, you'll sometimes run into ghosts who never quite moved on. Most of them used to work here at the school.
say:1:1623341001:1.female: In the Lyceum Graveyard, you'll sometimes run into ghosts who never quite moved on. Most of them used to work here at the school.

say:2:1623341002:1.text: And every now and then, they need a hand.
say:2:1623341002:1.source_cn: 这些幽灵偶尔会需要我们的帮助。
say:2:1623341002:1.male: And every now and then, they need a hand.
say:2:1623341002:1.female: And every now and then, they need a hand.

say:3:1623341003:1.text: Normally I'd go check in myself. But with school affairs piling up, I can't get away. Would you go for me and speak with them?
